item.tib: thugs rje sems dpa'i lugs kyi mtshan nyid gsum gyi rnam bzhag ga pur thigs pa
item.coloph: ces pa 'di ni slob gnyer ba 'ga' yis bskul ngor ris med kyi grub mtha' kun la yongs su 'dun pa'i btsun pa sangs rgyas bstan 'dzin gyis dpal gshen bstan bkra shis sman ri'i dgon du sbyar ba'i dge des rnam 'dren rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che phyogs dus gnas skabs kun tu dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas pa'i rgyur gyur cig/
